messages:
Marta (CS): Heads-up — SkywardOps emailed: they're launching a small UX team to embed search widgets into 3 product pages. Says early traffic will be modest but expects 3x token volume after pilot. Asked about latency targets and cost. cc @Evan
Evan (SE): Nice. Do we know model + endpoint they plan to use?
Marta (CS): Customer wants to stick with our hosted API (redwood-v1 family). No strict model req yet, they want guidance.
Lia (Onboard): I'll book a enablement session. Can we get estimated QPS and concurrency so I can tailor the walkthrough?
Marta (CS): From the email: prototype traffic ~50 QPS, ramp to ~150 QPS in weeks. Concurrent requests ~20 to 40. They mentioned page-level prefetching -> bursty.
Evan (SE): That pattern suggests we should recommend prefix caching + async prefetch to smooth spikes. Also suggest medium quantized model for cost.
Evan (SE): @ops-bot can you run a quick capacity check for a hosted plan handling 150 QPS with spikes to 250 for short windows?
ops-bot: Ticket created: #CS-6124. Quick simulation queued. ETA 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: Simulation done — baseline hosted pool can handle sustained 150 QPS with 95th P50 latency ~220ms for redwood-v1-medium. Spikes to 250 QPS risk 95th >500ms without batching or cache.
Marta (CS): Good — relay to customer: we can meet their SLOs with caching + batching, or offer a dedicated pool for guaranteed headroom. Estimate for Dedicated: $Xk/mo (ballpark).
Lia (Onboard): For enablement: I'll prepare a 30m session showing prefix caching, sample prefetch code, and a small dashboard for burst monitoring. Need an example request shape from them.
Marta (CS): I'll ask their PO for sample request size distribution and whether they pre-render pages. Also capturing feature ask: they want embedding id lookup for semantic nav later.
Evan (SE): If they plan embeddings later, recommend reserving a small embedding-config pipeline now — easier to test early. I'll draft best-practice notes.
Marta (CS): Also flagging potential expansion signal -> more teams after UX ships. Renewal touchpoint in 6 months might turn into Dedicated sale. Capture feedback now.
Lia (Onboard): Agreed. I'll add a survey after enablement to capture satisfaction + friction. We should log any roadmap asks into the account record.
Evan (SE): Action items:
- Evan: draft best-practices + cost comparison doc (hosted vs dedicated) — due EOD tomorrow.
- Marta: ask customer for request size histogram and preferred latency targets.
- Lia: schedule enablement + draft post-session survey.
- ops-bot: attach simulation output to ticket and run a dedicated-cost estimate if they ask.
Marta (CS): Thanks — I'll update the Salesforce account notes and set a follow-up for 2 weeks post-enablement. :rocket:
Evan (SE): If they confirm embeddings roadmap, we can propose a small pilot seat for vector store throughput testing.
Marta (CS): Noted. I'll propose pilot plan in the follow-up.
Lia (Onboard): I'll block time on calendars once Marta confirms sample payloads.
Marta (CS): End of thread — ping me if anyone gets the payload from SkywardOps before I update SFDC. :eyes:
